competition: 2026青年AI音乐嘉年华·单曲组·未来想象主题

target.key_strategy: E minor verses, G major chorus, C-D-Em suspended bridge, final chorus modulates up a whole step to A major
target.vocal_range: female lead A3-C5; final chorus peaks B4 with choir support; male fallback down 3-4 semitones

lead_voice.timbre: clear, sincere, youthful female lead, no grit, no scream
lead_voice.narrative_role: first-person student recording a song to the future; intro/outro radio-check spoken tone; outro answer line sung by backing layer

hook.strategy: sentence-level repetition only: hook pair (lines 1,3) verbatim across all choruses; chorus 2 upgrades all content lines (第二句会是你的回应/我的歌声正在靠近/回信正在穿过夜里/你收到请亮一下灯); final chorus flips line 3 已→我; no whole-section verbatim repeats (L8)
